explainer.counted: Refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in Slovenia as a share of all refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in every host country on 31 December 2025 ({n0} of {n1}).
explainer.type: A share: one year-end stock divided by another, both from the same source.
